faq.q: What is the Girardi ES9 in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a pistol that IGN reported seeing in official Grand Theft Auto VI material. IGN described it as Jason's chosen sidearm and said it can be personalized by owners of the Ultimate Edition.

faq.q: Is the Girardi ES9 Jason's pistol in GTA 6?
faq.a: IGN reported that it is. Rockstar has not named a sidearm for either playable character, so the link between Jason and this pistol rests on IGN's reporting rather than on anything Rockstar has published.

faq.q: What real gun is the Girardi ES9 based on?
faq.a: IGN reported that it looks to be based on the Beretta 92FS. That is the outlet reading a picture. Rockstar has never named a real firearm as the basis for a Grand Theft Auto weapon.

faq.q: Can the Girardi ES9 be customized in GTA 6?
faq.a: IGN reported that Ultimate Edition owners can personalize it. Rockstar's store page does list Personalized Weapon Variants as edition content, but it does not name this pistol, so what personalizing changes is not known.

faq.q: How much damage does the Girardi ES9 do?
faq.a: No damage, accuracy, magazine size or price has been published. The game has not released and Rockstar has issued no weapons list, so every stat quoted for this pistol today is a guess.

howWeKnow: IGN named this pistol in its Grand Theft Auto VI weapons list, read here on 2 September 2026, working from Rockstar's published screenshots. No Rockstar page fetched for this site carries the name. It is therefore recorded as a press report from a major outlet, not as an official listing.
